motivation: The original layer-28 two-head write near the answer changed zero of 24 public CAPITALS targets although the complete donor answered 20. Move the update to the document boundary, before any question arrives. Determine which cache components contain enough information to transfer both exchanged country assignments to all future queries. Distinguish recurrent from attention storage. Test whether the country-token positions and their punctuation are sufficient for a later donor-free local repair.
dataset: All 12 exposed CAPITALS pilot IDs and both pinned author templates, same three names and country assignments. Before any question swap the countries of subject seed%3 and the following cyclic subject. Issue three independent queries, one about each person from that one repaired cache. Two should change, one remains stable, giving 48 changed and 24 stable prompts across 12 clustered IDs. Unconstrained whole-vocabulary next token after the official completion wording. Score every case and native/updated baselines.
arms: Stale unaltered document, whole updated document, updated recurrent/convolution caches alone, updated attention K/V alone, donor K/V only at the two changed country-token rows, donor K/V at those rows plus their following punctuation, donor values only over those four rows, and donor keys only over the same rows. Include a zero-donor country-and-punctuation value swap using the original cache and an ordinary textual correction consisting of the two complete corrected statements appended to the old cache before the question. Full and donor-component controls read the updated source. Every other cache entry stays at its original token index. All queries branch independently, without earlier answers. Measure numerical agreement of full-clone and attention-plus-recurrence reconstruction with the full updated cache.
decision: Only proceed to calibrate a donor-free estimator at these four local attention rows if the oracle transplant (both K and V) controls >=6 more changed targets than the unaltered cache, loses at most two full updated-correct changed answers and keeps every stable answer the unaltered model got right. Otherwise discard the local repair premise for this task. The dense component ablations remain descriptive. A faster serving claim requires a later independent end-to-end timed serving comparison including initial ingestion, extracting the edit, compilation and subsequent queries, versus text correction and exact prefix-checkpoint replay.
budget: Local pinned 4-bit Qwen3.5-9B, development only, 10 minutes, one engineering repair, no paid credits. Unseen IDs remain locked until a deployable candidate is selected.
